race.comment: BRAVE FORTUNE (2) has returned in far better order this prep. Opened the campaign with a placing over 1100m at Bordertown then led and gave a great sight only to be ambushed late over the same journey at Gawler last Monday. Love the quick back-up over this slightly longer journey - ready to win. TASSORO (8) made a mid-race move to settle near the pace but couldn't muster again in the run home and missed the placings over 1400m at Murray Bridge at the last appearance two months ago. Nicely placed back to this trip while fresh. Should be highly competitive. BEL RUNNA (1) led and didn't do a bad job to hold on for fifth, beaten under three lengths, over 1325m at Geelong recently. Can run a cheeky race in this company. DEDSET MAGIC (4) has failed to live up to market expectations in two runs to date. Freshened up and worth one more chance. Market watch on debutant TOUCH OF FIRE (9) who trialled well recently following a gelding procedure.
